methodological_findings: Surface type and access state must be represented as independent dimensions.
A geographically restricted player does not cease to be an audiovisual-item surface when the page identifies a specific audiovisual unit.
The search_or_index class includes thematic result or index pages that aggregate multiple records under a specific term or subject.
Robots exclusion affects automated collection and must not be interpreted as a human-observed access failure or as a negative scientific finding.
This validation sample was assembled for surface-typing validation and must not be used to estimate prevalence of surface classes in the MAR corpus.
human_only_conclusion: The blind human review resolved all 17 units without unknown cases. Four units were identified as item-level audiovisual surfaces and thirteen as non-item-level surfaces. The review also exposed two representation requirements for M3: access restrictions must be tracked separately from surface role, and thematic result pages containing multiple records belong to search_or_index rather than item-level classes.
